caption: The drawing depicts a single, circular object resembling a ring-shaped vessel with a short, narrow neck at the top. The vessel is predominantly brown with a mottled, earthy texture, and it features cream or light yellow decorative patterns spaced evenly around its surface. The patterns consist of curved and linear motifs that stand out against the darker background. The interior of the ring is empty, forming a large central hole, and there are no other objects or elements in the composition. The object is centered on a plain, light beige background, and a signature with the name "Stewart" and the year "'78" appears near the bottom right of the image.
title: Ring-shaped Pottery Bottle
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
